eyebrow: LOAD CSV: into a running database
code:
LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS
FROM 'file:///customers.csv' AS row
MERGE (c:Customer {customerId: row.customerId})
SET c.name = row.name, c.email = row.email
caption: MERGE instead of CREATE keeps the import safely re-runnable.

code:
LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS
FROM 'file:///orders.csv' AS row
CALL {
  WITH row
  MATCH (c:Customer {customerId: row.customerId})
  CREATE (o:Order {orderId: row.orderId})
  CREATE (c)-[:PLACED]->(o)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1000 ROWS
caption: CALL { ... } IN TRANSACTIONS avoids one enormous transaction exhausting memory.
For a one-time initial load of millions of rows, before the database is live.
